summary.text: Dave Weeks is the incumbent state senator for the Rutland District and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election as a Republican and Democratic candidate.
A retired Navy captain and defense-sector program manager, he has served in the Senate since 2023.

paragraphs.text: David Weeks was born in Wallingford, Vermont, lives in Proctor and graduated from Mill River Union High School.

He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Vermont, an M.B.A. from the University of San Diego, an M.P.A. from Villanova University and a master's in strategic studies from the Army Command and General Staff College.

He served in the U.S. Navy and Navy Reserve and reached the rank of captain, and his career experience includes high-technology operations and project management on international contracts with the U.S. military.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Weeks said he serves as vice chairman of the Senate Education Committee and on the Senate Economic Development and Housing Committee.
He listed his campaign's key messages as lowering Vermont's health care costs, flattening the state budget and taxes, and addressing the state's transportation systems.
